opening.argument: The presentation promotes OneCoin through a claimed rise from two cents to two and a half euros, predicts that the currency will expand further, and links participation to income and further investment. It also presents an unusually high earnings claim, stating that 400 active partners earned €35,000 each week within 12 months. This is paired with a direct money-making prompt: viewers are told to click a button, provide their name and email, and join the program. Those features establish a solicitation built around token appreciation and income prospects, while the available evidence does not establish payment completion, actual earnings, or subsequent website behavior.

citations.quote: In time from 1 January until October 25, 2015 is the price one OneCoin coin has grown from two cents to two and a half euros.
And the currency will expand further. OneCoin provides two income options for you to trade. You can receive contributions for further investment.
This project offers an unique bonus plan. For 400 active partners, it took only 12 months to earn €35,000 each week.
Click the button below the video, I want to make money. You will be redirected to a registration form on which your name and your email address will only need to be entered.
